import hashlib,json,re
from pathlib import Path
log=Path('/work/.forge-stage7/own-proof/attempt-0001/independent-kernel.log').read_text()
paths=re.findall(r'^\[intern (.+?\.vo) \.\.\.$', log, re.M)
assert len(paths)==len(set(paths))==579, len(paths)
rows=[{'path':name,'bytes':Path(name).stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for name in sorted(paths)]
print(json.dumps({'record_type':'post-check compiled dependency identity; not a new kernel execution','modules':len(rows),'files':rows},sort_keys=True,indent=2))
